name: capture source Prefill Deployment
command: kubectl get deployment -n liangjiahao prefill-engine-deployment -o json

name: capture source Decode Deployment
command: kubectl get deployment -n liangjiahao decode-engine-deployment -o json

name: capture source runtime ConfigMap
command: kubectl get configmap -n liangjiahao layerwise-runtime-config -o json

name: capture source Pods
command: kubectl get pods -n liangjiahao -o json

name: render TP2 4096 REUSE3 canary
command: python3 features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/shared-buffer-functional-20260809T071622Z/npu/pure-consumer-canary/render-canary.py

name: render TP2 4096 REUSE3 canary retry
command: python3 features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/shared-buffer-functional-20260809T071622Z/npu/pure-consumer-canary/render-canary.py

name: apply REUSE3 runtime ConfigMap
command: kubectl apply -n liangjiahao -f features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/shared-buffer-functional-20260809T071622Z/npu/pure-consumer-canary/rendered/runtime-configmap.json

name: apply REUSE3 Prefill Deployment
command: kubectl apply -n liangjiahao -f features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/shared-buffer-functional-20260809T071622Z/npu/pure-consumer-canary/rendered/prefill-deployment.json

name: apply no-reuse Decode Deployment
command: kubectl apply -n liangjiahao -f features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/shared-buffer-functional-20260809T071622Z/npu/pure-consumer-canary/rendered/decode-deployment.json

name: capture REUSE3 Prefill Pods
command: kubectl get pods -n liangjiahao -l app=prefill -o json

name: capture no-reuse Decode Pods
command: kubectl get pods -n liangjiahao -l app=decode -o json

name: check REUSE3 Prefill runtime
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/prefill-engine-deployment -c prefill-engine -- python3 /opt/vllm-layerwise/check-runtime.py --role prefill

name: check no-reuse Decode runtime
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/decode-engine-deployment -c decode-engine -- python3 /opt/vllm-layerwise/check-runtime.py --role decode

name: capture pre-start Prefill NPU
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/prefill-engine-deployment -c prefill-engine -- npu-smi info

name: capture pre-start Decode NPU
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/decode-engine-deployment -c decode-engine -- npu-smi info

name: capture pre-start Master metrics
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/prefill-engine-deployment -c prefill-engine -- python3 -c from\ urllib.request\ import\ urlopen\;\ print\(urlopen\(\'http://mooncake-master-service:9003/metrics\'\,timeout=10\).read\(\).decode\(\)\,end=\'\'\)

name: start REUSE3 Prefill TP2
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/prefill-engine-deployment -c prefill-engine -- /opt/vllm-layerwise/start-prefill.sh

name: wait REUSE3 Prefill ready
command: kubectl wait -n liangjiahao --for=condition=Ready pod -l app=prefill --timeout=1800s

name: start no-reuse Decode TP2
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/decode-engine-deployment -c decode-engine -- /opt/vllm-layerwise/start-decode.sh

name: wait no-reuse Decode ready
command: kubectl wait -n liangjiahao --for=condition=Ready pod -l app=decode --timeout=1800s

name: sync exact-fixture canary client
command: kubectl cp -n liangjiahao features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/shared-buffer-functional-20260809T071622Z/npu/pure-consumer-canary/send-canary.py layerwise-performance-aisbench:/tmp/send-canary-20260809T071622Z.py

name: capture active Master metrics
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/prefill-engine-deployment -c prefill-engine -- python3 -c from\ urllib.request\ import\ urlopen\;\ print\(urlopen\(\'http://mooncake-master-service:9003/metrics\'\,timeout=10\).read\(\).decode\(\)\,end=\'\'\)

name: send exact 4096-token REUSE3 canary
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao layerwise-performance-aisbench -- env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 /tmp/send-canary-20260809T071622Z.py 4096 1

name: sync canary client into exact rootfs
command: kubectl cp -n liangjiahao features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/shared-buffer-functional-20260809T071622Z/npu/pure-consumer-canary/send-canary.py layerwise-performance-aisbench:/performance-workspace/rootfs/tmp/send-canary-20260809T071622Z.py

name: retry exact 4096-token REUSE3 canary in chroot
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao layerwise-performance-aisbench -c aisbench -- chroot /performance-workspace/rootfs env TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /client-tools/venv/bin/python /tmp/send-canary-20260809T071622Z.py 4096 1

name: capture post-request Master metrics
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/prefill-engine-deployment -c prefill-engine -- python3 -c from\ urllib.request\ import\ urlopen\;\ print\(urlopen\(\'http://mooncake-master-service:9003/metrics\'\,timeout=10\).read\(\).decode\(\)\,end=\'\'\)

name: capture REUSE3 Prefill log
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/prefill-engine-deployment -c prefill-engine -- cat /tmp/vllm-prefill.log

name: capture no-reuse Decode log
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/decode-engine-deployment -c decode-engine -- cat /tmp/vllm-decode.log

name: stop targeted prefill TP2
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/prefill-engine-deployment -c prefill-engine -- /opt/vllm-layerwise/stop-engine.sh prefill

name: stop targeted decode TP2
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/decode-engine-deployment -c decode-engine -- /opt/vllm-layerwise/stop-engine.sh decode

name: capture prefill NPU release
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/prefill-engine-deployment -c prefill-engine -- npu-smi info

name: capture decode NPU release
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/decode-engine-deployment -c decode-engine -- npu-smi info

name: restart Mooncake Master after targeted canary
command: kubectl rollout restart -n liangjiahao deployment/mooncake-master-deployment

name: wait Mooncake Master reset
command: kubectl rollout status -n liangjiahao deployment/mooncake-master-deployment --timeout=300s

name: capture final Master metrics
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/prefill-engine-deployment -c prefill-engine -- python3 -c from\ urllib.request\ import\ urlopen\;\ print\(urlopen\(\'http://mooncake-master-service:9003/metrics\'\,timeout=30\).read\(\).decode\(\)\,end=\'\'\)

name: validate targeted REUSE3 canary
command: python3 features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/shared-buffer-functional-20260809T071622Z/npu/pure-consumer-canary/validate-canary.py

name: remove exact canary client temp 1
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao layerwise-performance-aisbench -c aisbench -- rm -f -- /tmp/send-canary-20260809T071622Z.py

name: remove exact canary client temp 2
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao layerwise-performance-aisbench -c aisbench -- rm -f -- /performance-workspace/rootfs/tmp/send-canary-20260809T071622Z.py
